# ServiceMaster by Zaba

> > Chicago's trusted IICRC-certified disaster restoration company specializing in water damage, fire damage, and emergency cleanup services for residential and commercial properties.

ServiceMaster by Zaba is a locally-owned disaster restoration company serving Chicago and Illinois communities. They provide 24/7 emergency response for water damage, fire damage, mold remediation, and comprehensive cleaning services with IICRC certification.
